wide_spectrum.caveats: 41 source-matched FeI lines, Explicit neutral-H/He widths plus NONE/supplied/Cowley Stark prescription. H2 omitted to retain atomic EOS/continuum/O collision baseline; no HFS/isotope/molecular/other-species opacity; xi is varied at fixed solar thermal structure, not an atmosphere-equilibrium response. Corner H2 screen is not target chemistry or rigorous error bound. Kurucz LTE reservoir is separate from limited native Fe atom, ratio reported. Same transfer equation, no spectrum multiplication or opacity scale; Population mode explicitly recorded, optional bounded O SE; no Fe abundance measurement or opacity/continuum adoption.

policy: solar_kpno_kurucz2005_corrected: kpno_solar_atlas is registered telluric_required=no on basis 'line_selection', so tellurics are handled by per-line clean-line selection over 9 enumerated bands (RYA-460/786), not by a correction stage. telluric_applied=applied. No telluric_corrected declaration is made.
